title: Interior Designer Internship
note: Automotive interior design traineeship; Italian and English at B2 or above required.

facts.summary: Six-month traineeship in Italdesign's car interior design department with a tutor; scholarship and canteen access.
facts.duties: Develop interior concepts and storytelling, sketches and renderings, and Sub-D/Blender proportion models.
facts.requirements: Design degree; Photoshop, Blender or Alias Sub-D, KeyShot; Italian and English B2+.
facts.apply: Apply online through Italdesign's inrecruiting posting.
